About the Saga

Before the birth of our Empire, those bound by conviction built their Realm and called their brothers and sisters into fellowship.

The leylines they found, and followed, to their spring of living light.

Each heart was heard, and here the covenant of dominion was struck with the Dawn.

But the Fount was not finished.

— Archival Committee of the Citadel Repository of Letters, CP 804

About the Author

The following is a torn scrap of unmarked page, discovered tucked among recovered source documents. It bears no date. The writing is believed to be the Chronicler's hand. Whether he was aware it had been misplaced is not known.

— Archival Committee of the Citadel Repository of Letters
Third Day of the Tower, CP 791

They've asked me to write it down. The whole of it. The story of the High Council, the Realm, the children. And they want it unfiltered.

I thought of you immediately. You always said the day would come. Just like you always said to take good care of her.

I did my best, you know. For all the time we were given together.

Would you believe the snow has returned? Real snow, like in the stories.

I think it's time to begin.

I'll write something worth remembering. For you.

P.S. I should find somewhere safe to keep this. It would be just like me to lose it in the manuscript.
